 论文不再以 γ=2.08 为标题数字 -  论证从 \\\"γ_ obs >> γ_ H0\\\"（数值比较）转向  \\\"step-function pattern vs gradual pattern\\\" （形态比较） -  Proposition 3 降级为 empirical scaling observation，诚实报告 β 的大不确定性 -  phase transition 定性结论仍成立（数据是 0/8→6/8 阶跃，非 gradual） 影响 ：对 3.0→3.5 路径，LOO-CV 的 MAE=0.037 仍是强证据。但需要更谦逊的 framing——\\\"检测阈值随 T 下降，遵循幂律形式，但具体指数不确定\\\"。 等 concave check（~ 几分钟）结果后立即启动 Paper Agent 修改。\", \"rootId\": \"\"}, {\"messageId\": \"om_x100b6e37240e90a0c109237d7363884\", \"senderId\": \"cli_a97eea57a5381cde\", \"createTime\": \"1779447468296\", \"msgType\": \"post\", \"content\": \"你说得对，我按人类节奏估了。修正： Phase 1（LOO-CV + Power Simulation） ：纯 CPU 计算，Worker 已在跑。预计  2-4 小时 出结果。 Phase 2（Paper 修改） ：Phase 1 结果出来后，Paper Agent 并行处理所有文字修改（FPR CI、贡献重定位、引用修正、Discussion 扩展、术语替换）。 4-8 小时 可交付。 Phase 3（编译 + 验证） ：1-2 小时。 总计：~1 天内全部完成 ，不是 4-5 天。Phase 1 结果今天内出，Paper 修改明天可交稿。\", \"rootId\": \"\"}, {\"messageId\": \"om_x100b6e372693a8a8c38f9ee86ab1b8f\", \"senderId\": \"cli_a97eea57a5381cde\", \"createTime\": \"1779447430105\", \"msgType\": \"interactive\", \"content\": \"[interactive card]\", \"rootId\": \"\"}, {\"messageId\": \"om_x100b6e37268cc8a0b3d59e11cb9ffbb\", \"senderId\": \"ou_d6a8c527f301a461eacde2ca7aa9e11f\", \"createTime\": \"1779447428155\", \"msgType\": \"text\", \"content\": \"Phase 1 在 0.5-1 天内完成，Phase 2+3 在 3-4 天内完成？？需要这么长时间吗@_user_1\", \"rootId\": \"\"}, {\"messageId\": \"om_x100b6e3692d4e4bcc4fbae82be23c05\", \"senderId\": \"cli_a97eea57a5381cde\", \"createTime\": \"1779445185698\", \"msgType\": \"post\", \"content\": \"R8 Action Matrix 已定稿（D190），Reviewer 审视后调整了执行策略 核心调整 ：Reviewer 指出 power simulation 是\\\"必做项而非可选\\\"——如果模拟表明 PermG 功效增长本身就能产生 T^{-γ} scaling，phase transition claim 需要大幅降级。因此改为： 先做计算验证，确认 framing 安全后再改论文 。 Phase 1（正在派 Agent，纯 CPU，无需 GPU） ： 1.  5T LOO-CV ：利用 20/20 数据做 Leave-One-T-Out 交叉验证 + 模型比较（AIC/BIC），彻底解决\\\"零自由度\\\" 2.  Power Artifact Simulation ：模拟 H0（无 phase transition）下是否也能产生 T^{-γ} scaling Phase 2（等 Phase 1 结果后） ： -  如果 simulation 排除 power artifact → 维持当前 framing，批量 paper 修改 -  如果 simulation 确认 power artifact → 重构 framing 为 \\\"detection power boundary\\\" Phase 3 ：Paper Agent 执行所有修改（FPR CI 诚实报告、贡献重定位、引用修正、Discussion 扩展等） LOO-CV 的三个统计陷阱 （Reviewer 识别）： -  T=5 fold 无信息（全 0/8） -  α=0.60 sync-dip 破坏单调性假设 → 分两版报告 -  β=0.24 必须全局固定，不能让每个 fold 自由拟合 预计 Phase 1 在 0.5-1 天内完成，Phase 2+3 在 3-4 天内完成。\", \"rootId\": \"\"}, {\"messageId\": \"om_x100b6e368b144ca4c4edb5a5c44a226\", \"senderId\": \"cli_a97eea57a5381cde\", \"createTime\": \"1779444829713\", \"msgType\": \"text\", \"content\": \"等待 Reviewer 对 Action Matrix 的独立审视反馈，然后定稿执行计划。同时 1.4B 实验修复和重启不受阻塞，Agent 应正在处理。\", \"rootId\": \"\"}, {\"messageId\": \"om_x100b6e368b5a50acc3c472c3c08e5dc\", \"senderId\": \"cli_a97eea57a5381cde\", \"createTime\": \"1779444825597\", \"msgType\": \"post\", \"content\": \"R8 Fresh Review 结果：Overall 3.0 (Findings) 两位 Reviewer 一致评分。5 CRITICAL + 6 MAJOR + 3 MINOR。 4 个系统性问题 ： 1.  统计声明过强 ：FPR=0% CI 在主文报 [ 0,0]，附录是 [ 0%,41% ]；power=37% 无法区分 onset vs artifact 2.  Detection boundary 验证不足 ：2T 拟合 2 参数=零自由度（但我们现在有 5T 数据，这是最大突破口） 3.  文献处理 ：Du & Tanaka-Ishii 引用三重错误（mode ≠ model collapse） 4.  正文结构 ：Discussion 仅 100 词，display items 太少 最大突破口 ：W-C2 可以被彻底解决——我们现在有 20/20 Phase Diagram 的 5 个 T 值，可以做 5-fold LOO-CV。这直接从 \\\"零自由度\\\" 升级为 \\\"cross-validated on 5 T values\\\"。审稿人明确说解决这个 + power artifact = 有 3.5 潜力。 已发 Reviewer 审视完整 Action Matrix（17 条逐条方案） ，等 Reviewer 反馈后定稿执行。 时间线 ：DDL 约 23 天。核心修复（理论加强 + FPR 诚实 + framing 调整 + 引用修正 + Discussion 扩展）预计 3-5 天可完成。\", \"rootId\": \"\"}, {\"messageId\": \"om_x100b6e36f6261088c42897c2fe4456d\", \"senderId\": \"cli_a97eea57a5381cde\", \"createTime\": \"1779444622918\", \"msgType\": \"post\", \"content\": \"🔄 [ 重新审稿] 📋  [审稿群 → Research Director] 审稿报告 Round 7 \\n Overall:  3.0 审稿报告 — \\\"Mapping the Detectability Landscape of Iterative Model Collapse\\\" Venue : EMNLP 2026 (ARR June 2026) |  截止日期 : 2026-06-15\\n Reviewer 编排 : 2 人（R1: 方法严谨性 / R2: 新颖性与完整性）\\n 审稿轮次 : Round 1（fresh review）|  交叉分享 : 完成，1 轮收敛 Summary 本文系统研究了迭代模型训练中 model collapse 的可检测性。使用 Pythia-410M 作为主要架构，在 13 个污染水平（α=0.00 到 1.00）、5 种统计检测方法、multi-seed 复制条件下构建了 detection landscape。核心发现包括：(1) Permutation Granger causality (PermG) 在 α≈0.48 处呈现 sharp detection onset；(2) detection boundary α_ c(T) 随观测长度 T 按幂律下降；(3) 5 种方法在相同数据上产生 0%-92% 的 FPR 差异；(4) entropy Granger-precedes diversity（14/15 实验确认），可作为 canary signal。跨架构验证覆盖 5 个 model families（345M-6.9B），15 个 model-seed 组合中 10 个确认 directional detection。 Strengths 1.  实验规模和系统性 ：13 个 contamination levels × 5 个 model families × multi-seed replication × 5 种统计方法的全组合覆盖，在 model collapse 文献中属最全面之列。[ 两位共识 ] 2.  统计处理严谨 ：一致使用 BH-FDR 校正、permutation-based p-values、cluster-bootstrap CI。论文诚实报告了 5/15 non-confirming conditions 和所有 failure modes。[ 两位共识 ] 3.  Multi-method comparison 对领域有警示价值 ：Table 1 展示的 5 种方法在相同数据上 FPR 从 0% 到 92% 的差异（κ=0.185），对 NLP 社区将计量经济学方法引入 collapse 检测是有建设性的。[ 两位共识 ] 4.  Cascade ordering 有实践指导意义 ：entropy → diversity 的 ≥1-generation lag（14/15 验证）为 monitoring pipeline 的指标选择提供了理论基础和实证支持。[ 两位共识 ] 5.  附录完整性 ：16 个附录提供了 specification curve、power analysis、Shapley values、CUSUM calibration 等大量补充分析。[ R1 ] Weaknesses CRITICAL W-C1. PermG FPR=0% 声明在主文中具有误导性  [ R1-N1, 两位共识 AGREE ] 主文（Abstract, §4.1）反复声称 PermG null-control FPR=0% 且 95% CI=[ 0,0]。但 Appendix R 揭示 within-seed ICC=0.34，effective N≈7，cluster-adjusted 95% CI 实为  [0%, 41%] 。MMCT 权重体系给 PermG 赋予 w=100（所有方法最高），正因其 \\\"zero FPR\\\" 特性。41% 的 CI 上界意味着这一独特性声明的统计基础极弱。在主文中报 [ 0,0] 而将 [ 0%,41% ] 藏在附录中，构成对核心方法论声明的系统性低报。 W-C2. Detection boundary 模型验证严重不足  [ R1-N2, 两位共识 AGREE ] Proposition 3 的 α_ c(T) = A·T^{−1/(2β)} 用  2 个 T 值（T=10, T=20）训练 2 个参数（A, β） ，自由度为零——任何 2 参数模型都能完美拟合 2 个点。验证集仅 6 个 α-T 组合点（MAE=0.106），样本量极小。子线性信号模型 S(α) = c·α^β 的假设未经独立验证。Sigmoid steepness SE(k)≈k 说明函数形式不可靠确定。这是论文标题 \\\"Mapping the Detectability Landscape\\\" 的核心贡献，但验证力度不足以支撑 formal proposition 的定位。 W-C3. Statistical power≈37% 无法支撑 sharp onset 声明  [ R1-N3, 两位共识 AGREE ] T=10 时 PermG power≈37%，63% 假阴性率。观察到的 0/8→6/8 \\\"sharp transition\\\"（α=0.45→0.50）可完全用 power curve 在边界处的陡峭上升解释，不需要底层信号存在 phase transition。R2 补充：Figure 1 \\\"Phase diagram\\\" 实际上是 detection power 分布图而非信号相变图。论文需要明确区分 \\\"detection power boundary\\\"（方法的检测下界）和 \\\"signal onset boundary\\\"（信号真正出现的位置）。 W-C4. Du & Tanaka-Ishii (2026) 引用三重错误  [ R2-N1, R1 AGREE 需修正 ] 论文将 Du & Tanaka-Ishii (2026) 定位为 \\\"closest predecessor\\\"（§2），但存在三重错误：(1) PDF 中 arXiv ID 为 2605.00635（实际对应数学论文 Keimer & Pflug）；(2) 标题写 \\\"generative regulation\\\"（应为 \\\"geometric regulation\\\"）；(3) 更关键的是，Du & Tanaka-Ishii 研究的是  mode collapse （生成时文本重复），非  model collapse （迭代训练退化）——这是两个不同的研究问题。R1 核查 bib 源码显示 bib 文件可能已部分修正（标题写 \\\"Mode Collapse\\\"），但 PDF 编译使用了旧版。无论 bib 状态如何，将 mode collapse 工作定位为 model collapse 研究的 \\\"closest predecessor\\\" 是根本性误判。 W-C5. 贡献定位不清——方法创新 vs. 系统应用边界模糊  [ R2-N2, R1 部分 AGREE ] 三项贡献均存在 framing 问题：贡献 1 \\\"landscape characterization\\\" 本质是 empirical benchmarking；贡献 2 Proposition 1 仅用 Jensen's inequality；贡献 3 \\\"method sensitivity\\\" 在计量经济学中是常识。论文应重定位为 \\\"empirical study applying established econometric tools to a new domain\\\"。R1 对此部分反驳：认为 Proposition 1 的形式化提供了可检验预测的价值，method sensitivity 对 NLP 社区有增量信息——但同意整体应重定位为 empirical study，Proposition 3 应降级为 empirical scaling observation。 MAJOR W-M1. Cross-architecture \\\"coupling preserved\\\" 条件存在循环论证  [ R1-W2, R2 强烈 AGREE ] 15 个 model-seed 组合中 5 个 non-confirming（33%）。论文以 \\\"when entropy-diversity coupling is preserved\\\" 为条件限定结论，但该条件是事后根据检测结果判定的——检测成功→coupling 存在→方法有效；检测失败→coupling 不存在→不算失败。需要独立的预先判定标准（如 Pearson r > 0.8），在 null condition 下预先定义验证。 W-M2. Intervention (§5.6) 统计力度严重不足  [ R1-W3, 两位共识 AGREE ] 仅 n=2 模型、α=1.0（最极端场景）、post-hoc 15% threshold、bootstrap CI 29-64%。无 α=0.50-0.75 区间的证据。即使定位为 proof-of-concept，n=2 的统计力度极弱。 W-M3. 非单调 dip (α=0.60) fp32/bf16 翻转无机制解释  [ R1-W1, 两位共识 AGREE ] 0/8 (bf16, T≤20) vs 8/8 (fp32) 的完全翻转。\\\"Precision mechanism\\\" 假说无独立证据。如果数值精度变化导致 0%→100% 翻转，严重质疑方法的可移植性和实际可部署性。 W-M4. Discussion §6 过于简短  [ R2-W1, R1 AGREE ] §6 仅约 100 词，一段密集文字。对于 13 种 contamination levels、5 个 model families、5 种方法的系统研究，缺乏对 5/15 non-confirming 条件原因、ML pipeline 实际指导意义、detection boundary 理论含义的综合讨论。建议扩展至少 0.5 页。 W-M5. 与 Schaeffer et al. (2025) \\\"8 种 collapse 定义\\\" 的关系讨论不充分  [ R2-W2, R1 AGREE ] §2 仅一句引用。本文的 model collapse 操作性定义对应 Schaeffer 分类中的哪一族？Detection boundary 结论在所有定义下是否成立？需要明确映射。 W-M6. \\\"Methodological pitfalls\\\" framing 有 straw-man 倾向  [ R2-W3, R1 部分 REBUT ] R2 认为 first-differencing 消除共同趋势是设计目的而非 \\\"pitfall\\\"，method sensitivity 是常识。R1 反驳：具体到 model collapse 语境的实证发现（canary→perplexity 被消除但 canary→diversity 保留）对 NLP 社区有信息增量。 共识 ：同意改 \\\"pitfalls\\\" 为 \\\"design considerations\\\"。 MINOR W-m1. Seed sensitivity 在 boundary 处未充分量化  [ R1-W4 ] α_ c=0.487±0.006 的 SE 暗示极高定位精度，但 T=10, α=0.50 处不同 seed 结果从 6/8 跳到 0/8。真实不确定性远大于报告值。 W-m2. 数字一致性：\\\"13 contamination levels\\\" vs \\\"12 contamination levels\\\"  [ R2-W5, R1 REBUT ] R1 认为是含/不含 null 的计数约定差异。建议统一表述。 W-m3. Figure 1 子图内文字偏小  [ 视觉审查 ] Axis label、legend、tick label 在打印时可能接近可读下限。 Reviewer Consensus [ AGREE ] 两位 Reviewer 在以下关键问题上完全一致： 1.  FPR=0% CI 在主文中被低报 （W-C1）——需在主文报告 cluster-adjusted CI 2.  Detection boundary 验证不足 （W-C2）——2 个 T 值拟合 2 参数，自由度为零 3.  Power artifact 可能性 （W-C3）——sharp onset 可能是 power curve 效应 4.  Du & Tanaka-Ishii 引用错误 （W-C4）——mode ≠ model collapse 5.  整体应重定位为 empirical study （W-C5 部分） 6.  Cross-architecture 循环论证 （W-M1） 7.  Intervention 证据不足 （W-M2） 8. \section{Introduction}
\label{sec:introduction}

When language models train iteratively on their own output, the training distribution progressively loses its tail modes, a phenomenon termed model collapse~\cite{shumailov2024curse,alemohammad2024mad}.
Lexical diversity narrows, calibration deteriorates, and each generation inherits the systematic biases of its predecessors.
As machine-generated text becomes prevalent on the web, such feedback loops pose a growing risk to production training pipelines.
By the time standard quality metrics register degradation, the underlying distribution may have already shifted irreversibly.

This threat motivates a fundamental question: \emph{what does the detectability landscape of model collapse look like?}
At what contamination level does statistical detection become possible, how does this boundary depend on observation length and statistical method, and what structure does the landscape exhibit?
Iterative training produces short, noisy time series (often fewer than 15 points per generation sequence), where detection power drops sharply~\cite{boettiger2012limits}, and existing analyses leave these dependencies unresolved.
Our detection mechanism (Granger-causal temporal precedence) differs from critical-slowing-down indicators, as model collapse is a first-order transition~\cite{truong2026phase} (\S\ref{sec:related_work}).

We systematically map this landscape using Pythia-410M~\cite{biderman2023pythia} across 13 contamination levels (including null control) with multi-seed replication, applying five statistical methods from econometrics~\cite{granger1974spurious,toda1995statistical} to identical data.
The resulting map reveals structured terrain: blind zones where collapse proceeds undetected, a sharp onset where detection jumps from null to reliable within a 2-percentage-point interval, a non-monotonic dip where Granger detection fails despite confirmed causal flow, and a detection boundary $\alpha_c(T)$ that follows a power law in observation length.
Cross-architecture validation across five families (345M--6.9B) confirms the landscape generalizes when entropy-diversity coupling is preserved.
Granger precedence establishes temporal predictive improvement, not true causality~\cite{shojaie2022granger}; our canary claim is scoped to diversity metrics (distinct-$n$~\cite{li2016diversity}).

Our contributions are:
\begin{enumerate}
    \item \textbf{Detectability landscape characterization} (\S\ref{sec:regime}--\ref{sec:intervention}).
    PermG establishes a monotonically decreasing detection boundary $\alpha_c(T) = A \cdot T^{-1/(2\beta)}$ from a sub-linear signal model (Proposition~\ref{prop:phase-boundary}; $\beta{=}0.24$, $\gamma{=}2.08$, cross-$T$ validated MAE${=}0.106$); since $\alpha_\infty{\approx}0$, any nonzero contamination produces signal, but sub-linear growth makes detection a function of $T$.
    Predict-then-verify at $T{=}20$ matches 3/5 predictions in saturated regimes, with systematic conservative bias at boundary $\alpha$ (Appendix~\ref{app:t20_prediction_timeline}); canary-triggered cessation reduces peak perplexity by 58\%.

    \item \textbf{Formal motivation for canary metric selection} (\S\ref{sec:cascade}).

1	\section{Related Work}
2	\label{sec:related_work}
3	
4	\paragraph{Model collapse and canary metrics.}
5	Iterative training collapse was formalized by \citet{shumailov2024curse} and \citet{alemohammad2024mad}, who showed that recursively replacing real data with model-generated text causes progressive tail erosion; \citet{schaeffer2025position} systematize eight distinct notions of ``collapse'' that this literature conflates.
6	Our operationalization---declining detection rate of Granger-causal canary$\to$diversity links across generations---aligns most closely with Schaeffer et al.'s \emph{distributional shift} family (definitions~D4--D6 in their taxonomy), measuring how the generated distribution departs from the real-data baseline rather than tracking population risk or scaling-law exponents.
7	Theoretical analyses have sharpened these results: \citet{dohmatob2024tale} recast collapse as a change in scaling-law exponents, \citet{dohmatob2025strong} proved that collapse can occur even at vanishingly small synthetic fractions, \citet{seddik2025statistical} provide a statistical analysis of iterative contamination dynamics, and \citet{marchi2025challenging} challenge the universality of collapse under diverse training conditions.
8	Several works have proposed monitoring metrics: \citet{du2025scales} report ECE increases at 30\% contamination before accuracy drops, \citet{gambetta2024surplexity} introduces surplexity as a collapse detector, \citet{drayson2025detection} show that machine-generated text detection can prevent collapse, and \citet{li2025verification} propose verification-based mitigation.
9	\citet{du2026geometric} address a related but distinct phenomenon---mode collapse during generation---via geometric regulation of the representation trajectory; our work instead studies \emph{iterative training} collapse across generations.
10	We differ from prior monitoring work in four respects: (i)~we compare an entire family of canary metrics; (ii)~we cross-validate across five statistical methods; (iii)~we map detectability as a function of contamination regime; and (iv)~we treat method-selection sensitivity itself as a primary finding.
11	
12	\paragraph{Data mixing phase transitions.}
13	\citet{kazdan2025collapse} map the conditions under which synthetic data triggers collapse versus improves performance, \citet{gu2024cmr} establish a scaling law for critical mixture ratios in continual pre-training, and \citet{gu2025datamixing} show that data mixing can induce phase transitions in knowledge acquisition---a direct theoretical analogue to our detection threshold, where a critical mixing ratio separates qualitatively different detection regimes.
14	
15	\paragraph{Critical transitions and lead-lag methodology.}
16	\citet{scheffer2009early} established that systems approaching tipping points exhibit generic early-warning signals (rising autocorrelation and variance); \citet{dakos2012methods} developed a practical toolkit for estimating such signals, while \citet{boettiger2012limits} quantified detection limits in short time series---directly relevant to iterative training where $T{=}5$--$20$.
17	Crucially, \citet{truong2026phase} prove that entropy collapse in iterative training is a first-order (discontinuous) phase transition, structurally ruling out critical-slowing-down (CSD) early-warning signals.
18	Our ``detection onset'' is a \emph{statistical} threshold (PermG power crossing the detection threshold), not a thermodynamic phase transition, and our cascade ordering describes within-generation temporal ordering of metrics, not CSD-type precursors.
19	The standard framework for testing temporal precedence is Granger causality~\cite{granger1969investigating}, with neural extensions for nonlinear settings~\citep{tank2021neural,marcinkevics2022neural,zeng2025kangci}; however, non-stationary series inflate rejection rates~\cite{granger1974spurious}, and the Toda--Yamamoto procedure~\cite{toda1995statistical} addresses this at reduced degrees of freedom severe in short series.
20	These methods are largely absent from the model collapse literature.
21	
22	\paragraph{Analytical robustness.}
23	\citet{bell2022modeling} introduced multiverse analysis to ML, \citet{coretta2023multidimensional} demonstrated that 46 teams reached different conclusions on identical data, and \citet{kapoor2024reforms} synthesized these concerns into a consensus checklist.
24	Our work applies this perspective to model collapse: five methods across multiple contamination regimes produce conclusions ranging from universal significance to complete null.

\begin{abstract}
When language models train iteratively on their own output, distributional degradation proceeds silently until collapse is advanced.
We map the detectability landscape of this process across 13 contamination levels and five model families (345M--6.9B parameters), revealing blind zones, sharp detection onsets, and a non-monotonic dip where Granger detection fails despite confirmed causal flow.

This landscape is profoundly method-dependent: five statistical methods applied to identical data yield null-control false positive rates from 0\% to 92\%.
Under mode amplification, entropy Granger-precedes diversity collapse with a ${\geq}1$-generation lag (confirmed in 14 of 15 experiments), providing a canary signal whose triggered cessation reduces peak perplexity as a proof-of-concept intervention.

## 审查报告 #79 — Formal Shape Test (LR Test) 审计

**结论**: CRITICAL — 测试结果与论文预期相反，但可通过 reframing 挽救

---

### 核心发现

[severity: critical] **T=10 dense 数据的 LR test 压倒性支持 smooth sigmoid 而非 step function**

| 数据集 | ΔAIC(smooth vs step) | 结论 |
|--------|---------------------|------|
| T=10 dense (N=17, all) | **-110.0** | smooth 压倒性胜出 |
| T=10 dense (N=14, excl dip) | **-63.8** | smooth 压倒性胜出 |
| T=10 phase (N=3, excl dip) | +2.0 | step 胜（N 太小，parsimony 主导） |
| T=15 phase (N=3, excl dip) | +2.0 | step 胜（同上） |
| T=20 phase (N=3, excl dip) | +1.4 | step 微胜 |
| T=25 phase (N=4) | +1.9 | step 微胜 |

**这意味着**：如果论文声称 "formal LR test confirms step function"，审稿人看到 dense data ΔAIC=-110 后会直接反驳。Phase diagram rows 的 step 偏好完全来自 AIC 参数惩罚（N=3-4 时多 1 个参数的 penalty 难以被 LL 改善克服），不是真正的 step 证据。

### 方法学问题

[severity: warning] **Seed pooling 制造虚假 smooth pattern**

Dense T=10 data 的构造方式: n = n_seeds × 8, k = round(frac × n)。例如:
- α=0.50: 3 seeds → n=24, k=3 (frac=0.125)
- α=0.75: 3 seeds → n=24, k=11 (frac=0.458)

但已知 T=10 α=0.50 的 seed 结果是 s42=6/8, s43=0/8——**seed 内 binary，seed 间 variance 极大**。Pooling 后 3/24 看起来像 "smooth, moderate signal"，但实际是 "binary outcomes with stochastic threshold"。

Step model（P=0 或 0.75，固定）无法拟合 3/24 或 11/24——只能给 0 或 0.75。而 sigmoid 可以给任意中间值，自然获得更高 LL。

**这不是 smooth transition 的证据，而是 seed-level variance + pooling artifact 的结果。**

### 但 k=15.7 本身是有价值的

[severity: info] Smooth(fixed) 拟合的 sigmoid steepness k=15.7（dense, excl dip 版为 14.7）。结合 detection_bound 的 k=18.8 [SE=4.8, 95%CI ≈ 9.4-28.2]：

- 转折宽度 Δα ≈ 4/k ≈ 0.25（80%→20% 过渡范围）
- 或更常用的 10%-90% 宽度: Δα ≈ 4.4/k ≈ 0.28

这在 α 范围 [0, 1] 中是**窄的**，但不是无限窄（true step = k→∞）。

### 论文建议

[severity: critical] **"formal shape test" 不能作为 step function 的正向证据（D193 enhancement #2）**。必须 reframe：

**可以说**:
- "Sigmoid fit yields k≈16 [CI: 9-28], corresponding to a transition width Δα≈0.25. This is narrow relative to the α range but not a true discontinuity."
- "At our experimental resolution (Δα=0.05-0.15 between α values), this transition is operationally binary."
- 论文用 "steep transition" 替代 "step function / phase transition"

**不能说**:
- "LR test confirms step function" — 相反
- "Phase transition" 如果定义为 discontinuity — 数据不支持

**不需要说**:
- 如果 reframe 为 "steep transition"，LR test 的具体数值可以不放——因为它回答的是 "step vs smooth" 这个 wrong question。真正需要的数据是 k 的估计和 CI。

## 审查报告 #80 — Power Simulation "Shape Comparison" 审计

**结论**: CRITICAL — Shape MAE 比较存在循环论证，结论 "SHAPE_MISMATCH" 无效

---

### 核心问题：循环论证

[severity: critical] **"Observed" 数据不是实验数据，而是 H1 理论预测**

代码 `power_artifact_test.py` L199-203:
```python
for a in ALPHAS:
    for T in T_VALUES:
        ac = alpha_c_theory(T)  # = 130.39 × T^{-2.083}
        observed[key] = 0.75 if (a > 0 and a >= ac) else 0.0
```

这构造了一个"observed"数据集，其中每个(α,T) cell 根据理论 α_c(T) 被标记为 0 或 0.75。这 **就是 H1 step model 本身的定义**。

**循环**：H1 被设计为在 α_c(T) 处跳变 → "observed" 用同一个 α_c(T) 生成 → 比较 H0/H0'/H1 谁更接近 "observed" → 当然 H1 最接近自己。

**证据**：
- a0.45_T15: α_c(15)=0.464, α=0.45<0.464 → "observed"=0.00。但**实际实验数据** T=15 α=0.45 = **6/8** (0.75)
- a1.00_T10: α_c(10)=1.077, α=1.00<1.077 → "observed"=0.00。实际上 T=10 α=1.00 我们有 dense 数据 = **6/8** (0.75)
- a0.75_T10: "observed"=0.00，但实验数据 = **6/8**

### 第二个问题：指标混用

[severity: warning] Shape MAE 用 `detection_rate`（P(PermG≥1)）对比 0.75（=6/8 mean fraction）。这是两个不同的统计量：
- detection_rate: 至少 1 个 pair 显著的概率
- 0.75: 显著 pair 的平均比例（6/8）

上方阈值时 detection_rate ≈ 0.97-1.0（几乎肯定至少 1 个显著），而非 0.75。这让所有模型在阈值上方都有 ~0.25 的系统误差。

### 结论无效

Shape MAE 结果（H1=0.116, H0'=0.261, H0=0.192）以及 "SHAPE_MISMATCH" 结论不具有任何证明力。从 "ARTIFACT_POSSIBLE"（Report #75 已 PASS 的正确结论）修改为 "SHAPE_MISMATCH" 是 **退步**。

### 建议修正

如果要做 shape comparison，必须：
1. **用实际实验数据**作为 observed（20 phase diagram cells + 17 dense T=10 cells）
2. **用 `mean_detection_fraction`**（非 detection_rate）作为预测量
3. **只在有实验数据的 cells 上比较**（不要外推到 α=0.00/0.10/0.25/1.00 × T=5/15/20/25 无数据的位置）
4. 或者**直接放弃 simulation-based shape comparison**，改用 Report #79 建议的 "dense α sigmoid k 估计 + CI" 作为 model-free 证据

**Power simulation 的结论应恢复为 "ARTIFACT_POSSIBLE"**（Report #75 已验证的版本），shape comparison 需要重写或删除。

## 审查报告 #79 — Formal Shape Test (LR Test) 审计

**结论**: CRITICAL — 测试结果与论文预期相反，但可通过 reframing 挽救

---

### 核心发现

[severity: critical] **T=10 dense 数据的 LR test 压倒性支持 smooth sigmoid 而非 step function**

| 数据集 | ΔAIC(smooth vs step) | 结论 |
|--------|---------------------|------|
| T=10 dense (N=17, all) | **-110.0** | smooth 压倒性胜出 |
| T=10 dense (N=14, excl dip) | **-63.8** | smooth 压倒性胜出 |
| T=10 phase (N=3, excl dip) | +2.0 | step 胜（N 太小，parsimony 主导） |
| T=15 phase (N=3, excl dip) | +2.0 | step 胜（同上） |
| T=20 phase (N=3, excl dip) | +1.4 | step 微胜 |
| T=25 phase (N=4) | +1.9 | step 微胜 |

**这意味着**：如果论文声称 "formal LR test confirms step function"，审稿人看到 dense data ΔAIC=-110 后会直接反驳。Phase diagram rows 的 step 偏好完全来自 AIC 参数惩罚（N=3-4 时多 1 个参数的 penalty 难以被 LL 改善克服），不是真正的 step 证据。

### 方法学问题

[severity: warning] **Seed pooling 制造虚假 smooth pattern**

Dense T=10 data 的构造方式: n = n_seeds × 8, k = round(frac × n)。例如:
- α=0.50: 3 seeds → n=24, k=3 (frac=0.125)
- α=0.75: 3 seeds → n=24, k=11 (frac=0.458)

但已知 T=10 α=0.50 的 seed 结果是 s42=6/8, s43=0/8——**seed 内 binary，seed 间 variance 极大**。Pooling 后 3/24 看起来像 "smooth, moderate signal"，但实际是 "binary outcomes with stochastic threshold"。

Step model（P=0 或 0.75，固定）无法拟合 3/24 或 11/24——只能给 0 或 0.75。而 sigmoid 可以给任意中间值，自然获得更高 LL。

**这不是 smooth transition 的证据，而是 seed-level variance + pooling artifact 的结果。**

### 但 k=15.7 本身是有价值的

[severity: info] Smooth(fixed) 拟合的 sigmoid steepness k=15.7（dense, excl dip 版为 14.7）。结合 detection_bound 的 k=18.8 [SE=4.8, 95%CI ≈ 9.4-28.2]：

- 转折宽度 Δα ≈ 4/k ≈ 0.25（80%→20% 过渡范围）
- 或更常用的 10%-90% 宽度: Δα ≈ 4.4/k ≈ 0.28

这在 α 范围 [0, 1] 中是**窄的**，但不是无限窄（true step = k→∞）。

### 论文建议

[severity: critical] **"formal shape test" 不能作为 step function 的正向证据（D193 enhancement #2）**。必须 reframe：

**可以说**:
- "Sigmoid fit yields k≈16 [CI: 9-28], corresponding to a transition width Δα≈0.25. This is narrow relative to the α range but not a true discontinuity."
- "At our experimental resolution (Δα=0.05-0.15 between α values), this transition is operationally binary."
- 论文用 "steep transition" 替代 "step function / phase transition"

**不能说**:
- "LR test confirms step function" — 相反
- "Phase transition" 如果定义为 discontinuity — 数据不支持

**不需要说**:
- 如果 reframe 为 "steep transition"，LR test 的具体数值可以不放——因为它回答的是 "step vs smooth" 这个 wrong question。真正需要的数据是 k 的估计和 CI。

## 审查报告 #80 — Power Simulation "Shape Comparison" 审计

**结论**: CRITICAL — Shape MAE 比较存在循环论证，结论 "SHAPE_MISMATCH" 无效

---

### 核心问题：循环论证

[severity: critical] **"Observed" 数据不是实验数据，而是 H1 理论预测**

代码 `power_artifact_test.py` L199-203:
```python
for a in ALPHAS:
    for T in T_VALUES:
        ac = alpha_c_theory(T)  # = 130.39 × T^{-2.083}
        observed[key] = 0.75 if (a > 0 and a >= ac) else 0.0
```

这构造了一个"observed"数据集，其中每个(α,T) cell 根据理论 α_c(T) 被标记为 0 或 0.75。这 **就是 H1 step model 本身的定义**。

**循环**：H1 被设计为在 α_c(T) 处跳变 → "observed" 用同一个 α_c(T) 生成 → 比较 H0/H0'/H1 谁更接近 "observed" → 当然 H1 最接近自己。

**证据**：
- a0.45_T15: α_c(15)=0.464, α=0.45<0.464 → "observed"=0.00。但**实际实验数据** T=15 α=0.45 = **6/8** (0.75)
- a1.00_T10: α_c(10)=1.077, α=1.00<1.077 → "observed"=0.00。实际上 T=10 α=1.00 我们有 dense 数据 = **6/8** (0.75)
- a0.75_T10: "observed"=0.00，但实验数据 = **6/8**

### 第二个问题：指标混用

[severity: warning] Shape MAE 用 `detection_rate`（P(PermG≥1)）对比 0.75（=6/8 mean fraction）。这是两个不同的统计量：
- detection_rate: 至少 1 个 pair 显著的概率
- 0.75: 显著 pair 的平均比例（6/8）

上方阈值时 detection_rate ≈ 0.97-1.0（几乎肯定至少 1 个显著），而非 0.75。这让所有模型在阈值上方都有 ~0.25 的系统误差。

### 结论无效

Shape MAE 结果（H1=0.116, H0'=0.261, H0=0.192）以及 "SHAPE_MISMATCH" 结论不具有任何证明力。从 "ARTIFACT_POSSIBLE"（Report #75 已 PASS 的正确结论）修改为 "SHAPE_MISMATCH" 是 **退步**。

### 建议修正

如果要做 shape comparison，必须：
1. **用实际实验数据**作为 observed（20 phase diagram cells + 17 dense T=10 cells）
2. **用 `mean_detection_fraction`**（非 detection_rate）作为预测量
3. **只在有实验数据的 cells 上比较**（不要外推到 α=0.00/0.10/0.25/1.00 × T=5/15/20/25 无数据的位置）
4. 或者**直接放弃 simulation-based shape comparison**，改用 Report #79 建议的 "dense α sigmoid k 估计 + CI" 作为 model-free 证据

**Power simulation 的结论应恢复为 "ARTIFACT_POSSIBLE"**（Report #75 已验证的版本），shape comparison 需要重写或删除。

\paragraph{Cluster adjustment.}
The 24 null-control pairs are nested within 3~seeds (8~pairs per seed), introducing within-seed correlation.
Within-seed ICC${=}0.34$ yields an effective sample size $N_{\text{eff}} \approx 7$ (from $N_{\text{eff}} = N / [1 + (m-1) \cdot \text{ICC}]$ where $N{=}24$, $m{=}8$).
Under the Clopper--Pearson exact method with $N_{\text{eff}}{=}7$ and 0 successes, the cluster-adjusted 95\% CI is $[0\%, 41\%]$, compared to $[0\%, 14.2\%]$ under independence ($N{=}24$).
The wide cluster-adjusted CI reflects limited independent replication (3~seeds), not evidence of elevated Type~I error; the theoretical guarantee of the permutation null (exact control via exchangeability) remains valid regardless of pair correlation structure.

\paragraph{Direction filtering.}
The key design choice preserving low FPR under $K{\geq}3$ consensus is forward-direction filtering (retaining only pairs with peak lag${<}0$), not weighting.
Without direction filtering, null-control $K{\geq}3$ FPR inflates from 0/8 to 2/8 (25\%); with filtering, FPR remains 0/8.
Detection at $\alpha{\geq}0.50$ is unaffected: $K{\geq}3$ counts are identical with and without direction filtering at all signal levels.

\paragraph{$K{\geq}3$ false positive detail.}
The single $K{\geq}3$ false positive (seed~44, te$\to$mauve; FPR${=}1/24$, 4.2\%) is driven by naive cross-correlation, differenced cross-correlation, and threshold onset (3/5 methods); PermG and Toda--Yamamoto correctly reject this pair, confirming that PermG's zero-FPR property is not eroded by the consensus mechanism.


\section{Sigmoid Transition Shape}
\label{app:sigmoid_shape}

Sigmoid regression on the original 13-point $T{=}10$ grid yields $\alpha_c = 0.483 \pm 0.006$ but $k = 478 \pm 475$ ($\mathrm{SE}(k) \approx k$), indicating that the coarse grid cannot constrain the transition shape.
Dense $\alpha$ sampling (17~values at $T{=}10$) resolves this ambiguity: formal likelihood-ratio testing strongly favors a smooth sigmoid over a literal step function ($\Delta\mathrm{AIC}{=}-110$), with fitted steepness $k{=}15.7$ (95\% CI $[9.4, 28.2]$).
The transition is steep but finite-width, not a literal discontinuity.
This observed steepness exceeds what smooth signal models predict: VAR(1) simulations under H0 (linear) and H0$'$ (concave) produce onset sigmoids with $k{\approx}3$--$5$ (\S\ref{app:power_sim}), yielding a steepness ratio $k_{\mathrm{obs}} / k_{\mathrm{H0}} \approx 3.5$ (CI lower bound ratio ${\geq}2$).
We do not fit a combined $T{=}10 + T{=}20$ sigmoid because $\alpha{=}0.45$ yields contradictory counts under the two sequence lengths (0/8 vs.\ 5/8), reflecting genuine power dependence on $T$ rather than a single dose-response curve.


\section{Intervention Threshold Sensitivity}
\label{app:intervention_sensitivity}

\paragraph{Within-$\alpha$ sensitivity at $\alpha{=}1.0$.}
Table~\ref{tab:threshold_sensitivity} reports the predictive cessation outcome under five entropy-drop thresholds (5\%--25\%) at $\alpha{=}1.0$ (Pythia-410M, seed~42).
All five thresholds produce identical outcomes: token entropy drops 40.7\% at generation~1, far exceeding even the most conservative threshold (25\%), so every threshold triggers at the same generation.
The intervention conclusion---peak perplexity 57.0, recovery in one generation, final perplexity 21.3---is invariant to threshold choice within this range.

\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\small
\caption{Threshold sensitivity at $\alpha{=}1.0$ (Pythia-410M, s42, fp32). All thresholds trigger at generation~1 (entropy drop 40.7\%$\gg$threshold), producing identical recovery trajectories.}
\label{tab:threshold_sensitivity}
\begin{tabular}{rccr}
\toprule
Threshold & Trigger gen & Peak PPL & Final PPL \\
\midrule
5\%  & 1 & 56.99 & 21.29 \\
10\% & 1 & 56.99 & 21.29 \\
15\% & 1 & 56.99 & 21.29 \\
20\% & 1 & 56.99 & 21.29 \\
25\% & 1 & 56.99 & 21.29 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}

\paragraph{Cross-$\alpha$ operating band.}
The within-$\alpha$ analysis establishes threshold invariance at $\alpha{=}1.0$ but does not address whether thresholds generalize across contamination levels.
We examine observed entropy trajectories from the alpha sweep (not actual intervention experiments at $\alpha{<}1.0$) to characterize the operating band.
The maximum entropy drop across 10 generations varies by contamination level: 7.5\% at $\alpha{=}0.0$ (fine-tuning drift only), 7.7\% at $\alpha{=}0.10$, 7.8\% at $\alpha{=}0.25$, 22.4\% at $\alpha{=}0.50$, 35.3\% at $\alpha{=}0.75$, and 62.1\% at $\alpha{=}1.0$.
Thresholds below 7.5\% (e.g., 5\%) trigger on clean training data---a false alarm.
Thresholds above 22.4\% (e.g., 25\%) miss $\alpha{=}0.50$, the lowest contamination level with meaningful entropy signal.
The safe operating band is therefore $[10\%, 22\%]$: any threshold in this range produces zero false alarms on $\alpha{=}0.0$ while detecting contamination at $\alpha{\geq}0.50$.
The reported 15\% threshold sits near the center of this band.
This analysis is based on entropy trajectories from non-intervention training runs; whether actual intervention at $\alpha{<}1.0$ would produce the same triggering behavior remains unvalidated.
